preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 250.
The lengths of strings S and P must be between 1 and 60.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in S + P)
preconditions.description: Strings S and P must only contain characters from 'a'-'z' and 'A'-'Z'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Possible' if any(P == S[:i] + S + S[i:] for i in range(len(S) + 1)) else stdout == 'Impossible'
postconditions.description: Output 'Possible' if P can be formed by inserting S into itself, otherwise output 'Impossible'.
